gherkin.scenario: Update company week schedule to include weekends
given: I am logged in as an administrator
when: I check the Saturday checkbox in Company week schedule
I check the Sunday checkbox in Company week schedule
then: I should see a success message "Schedule for company was saved"
The company week schedule should include Saturday and Sunday

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The page should display "Schedule for company was saved"
Saturday should be checked in the company week schedule
Sunday should be checked in the company week schedule
